proposed_comments.title: Cache repeated ICU Unicode-name lookups
proposed_comments.body:
### Cache repeated ICU Unicode-name lookups

**Severity:** `medium`

`GetCharacterName` crosses the native ICU boundary for every code point whenever the guide or toolbar rebuilds descriptions. Cache results by code point, including empty-name results, while preserving the ICU-unavailable fallback.

**Verification:** Add coverage proving repeated lookups reuse the cached result and exercise the guide through repeated navigation.

confidence.rationale: The UI-facing refresh path repeats deterministic native lookups; the converged fork cache builds successfully.

proposed_comments.title: Add direct tests for the ICU Unicode boundary
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required direct test file and test cases are not present in the current upstream diff.
proposed_comments.body:
### Add direct tests for the ICU Unicode boundary

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccent.Common/UnicodeHelper.cs` and a focused test file under `src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccent.Common.UnitTests`.

**Problem:** The new native ICU boundary is tested only indirectly through Settings view-model behavior, whose fallback can hide a wrong entry point, surrogate-pair enumeration error, or decoding regression.

**Why it matters:** A broken native boundary can silently display fallback glyphs instead of Unicode names while existing UI tests continue to pass.

**Suggested change:**
1. Add direct `UnicodeHelper.GetCharacterName` tests outside Settings UI.
2. Cover a known BMP character and a supplementary-plane character.
3. Cover a multi-code-point sequence and unnamed, control, or private-use input.
4. Assert joined names and null fallback behavior explicitly.

**Verification:** Build the PowerAccent Common unit-test project and run the new focused tests with `vstest.console.exe` on supported Windows.

confidence.rationale: The new native boundary lacks direct assertions and its fallback can mask integration defects.

proposed_comments.title: Expose Unicode descriptions to screen readers
proposed_comments.body:
### Expose Unicode descriptions to screen readers

**Severity:** `medium`

Each character copy button exposes only its glyph as the UI Automation name. That is unclear for many symbols and especially for combining marks rendered with a dotted circle, even though the Unicode description is already available through the tooltip.

Bind `AutomationProperties.Name` to the same tooltip description.

**Verification:** Run an accessibility inspection and confirm each button announces the character description and copy purpose.

confidence.rationale: The icon-only glyph name is not reliably intelligible, while the existing tooltip provides the intended accessible description.

proposed_comments.title: Add an accessible name to the back button
proposed_comments.body:
### Add an accessible name to the back button

**Severity:** `low`

The new icon-only back button has no accessible name, so assistive technology may announce only “button.” Reuse the existing localized `BackBtn` resource by assigning the corresponding `x:Uid`.

**Verification:** Inspect the control with Narrator or Accessibility Insights and confirm the localized Back name is exposed.

confidence.rationale: The icon-only control has no content or automation label and the repository already has the localized resource.

proposed_comments.title: Use US spelling in the en-us resource
proposed_comments.body:
### Use US spelling in the en-us resource

**Severity:** `low`

This string is under `Strings/en-us` but uses the British spelling `organised`. Change it to `organized` for locale consistency.

**Verification:** Run the repository spelling check and inspect the rendered English resource.

confidence.rationale: The locale is explicitly en-us and the current resource uses British spelling.

proposed_comments.title: Remove stale UnicodeInformation metadata
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: NOTICE.md and .pipelines/ESRPSigning_core.json are not part of the current upstream PR diff.
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove stale UnicodeInformation metadata

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `NOTICE.md` and `.pipelines/ESRPSigning_core.json`, corresponding to the removed `UnicodeInformation` package reference.

**Problem:** The package is removed from project metadata while its notice entry and `UnicodeInformation.dll` signing-policy entry remain.

**Why it matters:** Repository notice verification and signing metadata checks can fail or continue treating an obsolete binary as a shipped dependency.

**Suggested change:**
1. Remove the `UnicodeInformation` package entry from `NOTICE.md`.
2. Remove the obsolete `UnicodeInformation.dll` entry from `.pipelines/ESRPSigning_core.json`.
3. Confirm no project or packaging reference still requires the dependency.

**Verification:** Run `.pipelines\verifyNoticeMdAgainstNugetPackages.ps1 -path .\src` and the repository notice/signing validation on a clean Windows checkout.

confidence.rationale: The dependency removal is current while both repository metadata references remain; the converged fork removes them.
